solstheim tomb of the snow prince.esm.summary: Warning: major Bloodmoon land revision; many Solstheim mods will not work.
solstheim tomb of the snow prince.esm.text: Solstheim Tomb of the Snow Prince is a major landmass revision of Bloodmoon's Solstheim. It makes a number of mods impossible to use: mods that edit Bloodmoon's Solstheim land or cells, or that were built for the vanilla Solstheim layout.
solstheim tomb of the snow prince.esm.incompatible_heading: These installed plugins already touch Bloodmoon's Solstheim cells, and are likely incompatible:

exclude: Solstheim Tomb of the Snow Prince.esm
